subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand multimodal memory beyond shipped image/audio extraPaths into PDF/video files and remembered session attachments, and what consent, retention, and provider-upload contract should govern that?
rationale: The remaining work crosses public memory config, persisted session/media state, and remote provider upload boundaries, so automation should not choose the product/security contract.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Keep this issue open and define opt-in consent, retention, MIME/size/provider upload, reindexing, and result-presentation rules before implementation.

options.title: Limit core to shipped subset
options.body: Treat image/audio extraPaths as the supported core scope and defer PDF/video/attachments until a separate plugin or product plan owns them.

options.title: Expand extraPaths only
options.body: Add PDF/video indexing for configured extraPaths while explicitly leaving chat attachments out until a retained-media contract exists.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define opt-in consent, retention, MIME/size/provider upload, reindexing, and result-presentation rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras introduced the current multimodal memory subset and is the clearest owner for deciding how far that surface should expand.
